title: Canonical maps of the inverse-twist projective-line decomposition
statement: For a commutative coefficient ring A killed by a positive integer N, construct the canonical transport and evaluation helpers used by the signed twist and decomposition map of [def-sp-p1-decomposition-arrows]. Project the normalized finite signed twist data of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] to a compact record retaining its roots, line, product and normalization equations. Derive the sheaf pullback, product and its evaluation equation. Construct the shifted pullback comparison, degree-zero tensor and evaluation comparisons, and evaluation after cancelling shifts -2 and 2. Define the unit component and tensor-evaluation adjunct h for a supplied c. Define a generic shifted comparison, tensor adjoint and biproduct comparison, and the source comparison for change of base. These helpers are explicit canonical composites independent of the splitting theorem. This node does not own p1DecompositionTwist or p1DecompositionMap; their existing owner is [def-sp-p1-decomposition-arrows].

proof.text: Construct every displayed map by the stated functors, isomorphisms and adjunctions. The negative product is evaluation by the n=0 normalization of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. The generic shift, tensor-adjoint and biproduct constructions abbreviate these same composites.
